title: Chromatics
description: Datapack for better Dye sources, consistent Universal dyeing and recycling Stained blocks!
body:
# Choco's Chromatics!

Ever wondered why certain single Items seeps an entire Dye, when staining other Blocks only requires ⅛? No worries! This datapack corrects this inconsistency across various Colouring recipes (universal Dyeing) for precise output; while providing several new sources for Dyes, making them more accessible!

### Credits

- Thank you [WASD](https://modrinth.com/user/WASDBuildTeam) for letting me optimise and incorporate [Dyeable Shulkers](https://modrinth.com/datapack/wasd-dyeable-shulkers)! Visit their [Website](https://wasdbuildteam.website/data-packs/) for other reinventive Projects!

### Other Resources
